signature.name: VTask.mapEquivMonic
signature.type: (R : Type u_1) -> (S : Type u_2) -> [CommRing R] -> [CommRing S] -> [Algebra R S] -> (n : ℕ) -> (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R →ₐ[R] S) ≃ Polynomial.MonicDegreeEq S n

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is a total equivalence of types for all valid inputs (any commutative rings R, S with an algebra structure and any natural number n), with no junk values or special edge-case conventions needed.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (S : Type*) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (n : ℕ), Function.Bijective (VTask.mapEquivMonic R S n).toFun
